description_en: The two-tiered temple lies about 300 m north of Patan Darbar Square. Its entrance and woodentoraṇacan be found at its western side. A bell around 50cm in height hangs at the right side of the entrance. The sanctum contains a stone statue of Viṣṇu (Nārāyaṇa) and statues of Viṣṇu and Garuḍa without wings (on the right side) and Lakṣmī, as well an inscription (both on the left side). 20 carved struts support the first roof, and 12 support the second. To the west, 3 meters away from the temple, one can find an anthropomorphic Garuḍa statue in a gesture of worship. Between this statue and the temple is a relief of a snake (Śeṣa), which is surrounded by an iron railing. 108 small oil lamp plates surround the temple on all sides. On the eastern side (and so at the back of the temple), there is a stone statue of a four-armed Viṣṇu together with his consort Lakṣmī and white tiles. The central piece of the door lintel contains a small image of Viṣṇu, while the tympanum contains an image of Vaiṣṇavī, the female form of Viṣṇu. The lintel band around the temple bears an inscription from VS 1946: according to the engraved text, it was donated by Haranava Siṃha.The struts depict parts of the Prahlāda legend (seeGail1984,NepālikabhūpavaṃśāvalīI: 55).The Viṣṇu statue behind the temple holds a jewel in the form of an ovoid between his thumb and forefinger (cp. Gail 1984: 30ff.) (now missing)
description_ne: दुईवटा छाना भएको यो मन्दिर पाटन दरबार स्क्वायरबाट लगभग ३०० मिटर उत्तरपट्टि रहेको छ । यस मन्दिरको प्रवेशद्वार र काठको तोरण मन्दिरको पश्चिमपट्टि रहेको छ । प्रवेशद्वारको दायाँपट्टि एउटा ५० सेमी उचाइ भएको घण्टा झुण्ड्याइएको छ । मन्दिरको गर्भगृहमा नारायणको शिलानिर्मित मूर्ति छ र त्यही शिलामा  नारायणको दायाँ लक्ष्मी र बायाँ गरुडको मूर्ति छ । मूर्तिको देब्रेपट्टि भित्तामा एउटा शिलाको अभिलेख टाँसिएको छ । मन्दिरको तल्लो छानालाई थाम्न २० वटा र माथिल्लो छाना थाम्न १२ वटा टुँडाल राखिएका छन् । मन्दिरको पश्चिमपट्टि पेटीबाट लगभग ३ मिटरको दुरीमा मानवीकृत स्वरूपमा निर्मित गरुडको मूर्ति प्रार्थना गरिरहेको मुद्रामा रहेको छ । यो मूर्ति र मन्दिरको बीचमा शेष नागको आकृति छ जसको वरिपरि फलामको बार हालिएको छ । मन्दिरको वरिपरि पेटीमा १०८ वटा साना दीपमालिका राखिएको छ । मन्दिरको पूर्वपट्टि अथवा मन्दिर पछाडि चार हात भएका विष्णुको मूर्ति छ र यसको वरिपरि टायल लगाइएको छ । मन्दिरको ढोकाको चौकसमा वैष्णवी र विष्णुका साना प्रतिमा छन् । मन्दिरको पहिलो तलाको दलिनको वरिपरि जडिएको पट्टिमा अभिलेख पनि छ जसअनुसार विसं १९४६ मा हरनव सिंहले यो दान गरेका थिए ।मन्दिरका टुँडालहरूमा प्रह्लादको कथा कुँदिएको छ (seeGail1984,NepālikabhūpavaṃśāvalīI: 55)।
brick_type: dāci apā (conical veneer brick), mā apā (regular fired brick)

historical_events.event_description: Śrīnivāsamalla (r. 1661-1684) and Kīrtisiṃha Bāde, prime minister (cauthāra) of Śrīnivāsamalla established the temple.
Donation of several ornaments in the years NS 841and 874, VS 1842
Donation of several ornaments for the façade by Nāla Lakṣmī, Tādhimana, an oil-lamp balustrade (NS 1028) and a bell (NS 1029). For more documents seeHDN, s.v. Svatha
Renovation of the upper roof and pinnacle
Construction of shrine and donation of the Kṛṣṇa statue by Dhenu Bhava Śarmā, in the name of his late daughter Māra Bhava Śarmā
Paving tiles repaired by Bijaya Lala
